stem: Which quotation best suggests that Kevin probably feels increasing pressure from external expectations?

options.label: F
options.text: When he was four he was better than the five-year-olds, and when he was five he was better than the seven-year-olds. (paragraph 1)

options.label: G
options.text: Year after year they have heard the boy’s body grow—the banging becoming harder and harder, faster and faster. (paragraph 3)

options.label: H
options.text: "Kevin? He’s the real deal," Peter Andersson, general manager of the club, always says, and he ought to know. . . . (paragraph 4)

options.label: J
options.text: Kevin knows what it takes; everyone’s been telling him ever since he first stood on a pair of skates. (paragraph 5)
